newsitem.title: DUBAI: Fifteen killed, 38 injured in Saudi bus crash.
newsitem.headline: Fifteen killed, 38 injured in Saudi bus crash.

text.p: Six women and nine children were killed and 38 other passengers injured on Wednesday when a bus ran off the road in Saudi Arabia and overturned, a Saudi traffic official said.
The official said the accident occured near the northern city of Arar in the early hours of the morning after the public transport bus crossed the border from Jordan.
In Amman, a Jordanian official said 13 Jordanians were killed and 23 were injured in the crash.
The official Petra state news agency said Crown Prince Hassan had ordered two military helipcopters to transport the injured Jordanians for treatment in Amman's specialised Hussein Medical Centre.
The Saudi official had given no breakdown of the nationalities of the victims but said the passengers were Saudis, Palestinians and Jordanians.
